title: Pre-existing Playwright read-only-mode tests now invert the intended UI state
resolution: Renamed OrderDetail_ReadOnlyMode_StatusTransitionButtonsNotShownAsync to OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_SeesStatusTransitionButtonsAsync and OrderDetail_ReadOnlyMode_ItemAndNoteControlsNotShownAsync to OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_SeesItemAndNoteEditControlsAsync. Inverted the assertions to positive checks that the status-transition buttons (when not in a terminal state), 'Add Product', and 'Add Note' are visible to SystemAdmin.

title: OrderService.UpdateAsync has no IsModifiable status guard
resolution: Intentional. The existing OrderService.UpdateNoteAsync and DeleteNoteAsync also do not check IsModifiable (only AddItem/AddNote/RemoveItem do). The spec requires SystemAdmin to edit header-level Notes and ShipDate on an order; blocking edits on Shipped/Delivered/Cancelled orders would prevent an admin from correcting notes or ship dates after the fact. Keeping behavior consistent with existing note update/delete is the safer choice and can be revisited with explicit product direction.

title: Integration test does not cover Customer endpoint-layer block for their own order
resolution: Added a doc-comment on Customer_CannotUpdateOtherCustomerOrderAsync explaining the two gating layers (security-config.json UpdateOrder.AllowedRoles enforced by the ASP.NET pipeline, plus OrderService.ApplyRowFilter). The endpoint-authorization layer is covered by Dabbler.Security tests; the row-filter layer is covered by this test.

title: Dirty state on header lost without warning when clicking a status transition
resolution: OrderDetail.razor status-transition buttons now disable whenever _isDirty is true, with a caption 'Save or undo header changes before changing status.' next to them.

title: Missing GET /api/orders/{id}/notes endpoint
resolution: Notes CRUD lives in src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Controllers/OrderNotesController.cs (HttpGet, HttpPost, HttpPut, HttpDelete for /api/orders/{orderId}/notes/*). The verifier saw only the OrdersController contents I supplied; the separate OrderNotesController file was not in the prompt.

title: Missing PUT/DELETE note endpoints
resolution: Same as Issue 5 — all note CRUD is in OrderNotesController.cs.

title: Discount semantics disagree between client and server
resolution: Pre-existing bug, unrelated to this session's fix. OrderDetailState.CalculateLineTotal (client display) divides Discount by 100, while OrderService.AddItemAsync/RemoveItemAsync (server persisted Total) does not. This is out of scope for the SystemAdmin edit-path fix and should be addressed as a separate session with explicit tests for both layers.
